latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Resolve via open_meteo.geocode if the operator gave a place name.

place_name.description: Optional — echoed back in the response so the SPA chat-component cards can label the result ("Reykjavík" rather than coordinates).

timezone.description: IANA timezone name ("Europe/Reykjavik") or the literal "auto" to use the coordinate's local zone. Default "auto".

forecast_days.description: How many days ahead to forecast (1-16, default 7).

past_days.description: How many days of history to prepend (0-92, default 0).

current.description: Current-conditions variables. Common: temperature_2m, apparent_temperature, weather_code, wind_speed_10m, wind_direction_10m, relative_humidity_2m, precipitation, cloud_cover.

hourly.description: Hourly variables — see https://open-meteo.com/en/docs for the full list.

daily.description: Daily variables. Common: temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_min, precipitation_sum, precipitation_probability_max, weather_code, wind_speed_10m_max, sunrise, sunset.

models.description: Specific forecast models to use (e.g. ["gfs_seamless"], ["icon_seamless","ecmwf_ifs04"]). Omit for Open-Meteo's default best-fit.
